capabilities: Encrypt note bodies and selected frontmatter values
Lock selected notes, text or files
Retain existing preferences and local recovery records
Connect a Constance account and buy credits
Check payment status and cancel pending purchases
extras: Account and billing use Constance v2; purchases are via Paddle in USD; analytics and error reports go to Datadog; passwords are not saved; requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later.
problem: Sensitive note bodies and frontmatter values remain plain Markdown in the vault unless the user encrypts them separately.

relations.evidence: Connect your Constance account in plugin settings.
New purchases use Paddle and USD.
automatic startup and plugin error reports sent to Datadog

summary: Local password-based encryption plugin that locks note bodies and selected frontmatter values, with Constance account billing for credits.
